operating_notes.text: DoT has raised a ₹975.42 Cr licence-fee demand on the parent (principal ₹228.65 Cr plus interest and penalty), treated as a contingent liability with no provision; TDSAT has stayed the demands and the petition is pending.
GTPL Broadband carries an estimated ₹384.19 Cr contingent liability for licence fees including interest and penalty, with no provision recognised.
Cable TV segment revenue was ₹982.60 Cr in Q2FY27 against ₹802.64 Cr a year earlier, but the segment result swung to a ₹9.11 Cr loss.
Active digital TV subscribers reached 11 Mn and paying subscribers stood at 10.30 Mn in Q2 FY27.
Acquired ACT Group cable TV business added approximately 6 lakh subscribers (including 1.25 lakh primary subscribers) for ₹35.55 Cr cash consideration on September 15, 2026.
Timeline for acquiring the balance 74% equity shares of DL GTPL Cabnet Private Limited extended to November 30, 2026.

timeline.summary: Pruthvi Broadcasting Services Private Limited, as promoter of GTPL Hathway Limited, declares no encumbrance on GTPL shares held during FY2025-26.
Kanaksinh Bhurubha Rana, Promoter of GTPL Hathway Limited, declared no encumbrance on its shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Anirudhsinh Noghubha Jadeja, Promoter of GTPL Hathway Limited, declared no encumbrance on its shares during FY2025-26 on April 04, 2026.
GTPL Hathway reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,146.4 Cr (+19% YoY) and a net loss of ₹0.5 Cr.

GTPL Hathway Limited shared the audio recording of its Post Results Conference Call for Q2 FY27 via [link](https://webapi.gtpl.net/WebSiteImages/InvestorRelation/Financial_Results/2026-2027/Q2/GTPL%20Q2%20FY27%20Recording.mp3) on October 14, 2026, signed by Ashwin Kumar and AR Jivanbhai Jivanbhai Patel.
GTPL Hathway held its Q2FY27 post-results call, detailing the acquisition of ACT Group's cable TV business for ₹35.55 Cr and plans for HITS platform transition.
GTPL Hathway extended the deadline to acquire the remaining 74% stake in DL GTPL Cabnet Private Limited to November 30, 2026.
